page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6r.large is an arm64-based virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Ampere Altra processor running at 2.8 GHz. The instance is configured with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include any local storage or GPU hardware accelerators, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark evaluations indicate modest performance characteristics. Single-core CPU performance via stress-ng is rated as average, scoring 1824.28, while multi-core performance drops to the bottom 25% with a score of 3617.67. Memory bandwidth tests show weak to poor performance, with read-only large block speeds at 26.08 GB/sec and write speeds at 16.11 GB/sec. Passmark CPU and memory metrics consistently fall into the bottom 10%, reflecting the entry-level nature of this hardware profile.

Given the dedicated arm64 architecture and 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance represents a cost-efficient option for lightweight, compute-focused workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local storage. It is suitable for basic web serving, simple database operations, and lightweight containerized applications. However, tasks requiring high memory bandwidth, advanced vector extensions, or intensive multi-threaded processing will face performance bottlenecks.
